You: Hello, this is the accounts payable assistant at Northwind Bakery Oy. We received invoice PP-24369 with a new IBAN FI56 6699 9533 5036 41. Can you confirm whether this new IBAN is valid for Puhdas Pinta Oy?
Laura Saarinen, Puhdas Pinta Oy: Hello! Yes, I can confirm the change. The new account is FI56 6699 9533 5036 41 at Ålandsbanken. Thank you for checking with us.

You: Hello, this is the accounts payable assistant at Northwind Bakery Oy. We received invoice RL-58852 with a new IBAN FI71 9933 1090 1651 75. Can you confirm whether this new IBAN is valid for Rautio Logistiikka Oy?
Olli Jokinen, Rautio Logistiikka Oy: We have not changed banks. Someone may be pretending to be us. Please do not pay that invoice to the new account.
